Public candidates require three matching vacancy signals, a vacant-land class, and primary R zoning other than R1/R2. No capacity minimum is applied here: use the lot-area and Point 6/Point 7 controls below to filter. Known park, transport, utility, and dedicated institution sites are screened out; federal lots without an identified agency are held out. Each site still needs agency and parcel review.

Source: NYC PLUTO 26v2 and the supplied City-owned vacant parcel inventory. Private / unknown retains OwnerType P or blank after public-owner checks; blank is unverified. City, State, and federal groups use ownership codes and owner names, then a stricter vacant-site screen. Public ownership or mapped residential zoning does not establish that land is surplus, available, or buildable. Public lots may require disposition and land-use approvals; R3–R5 multifamily eligibility and all building envelopes require parcel review. Point 6 and Point 7 capacity is PLUTO ResidFAR × LotArea, not a feasibility determination. Lots without coordinates remain in the matching count but cannot appear on the map.
